name: OpenCode with Config
description: Configures OpenCode with host-side configuration for seamless authentication. Depends on the official OpenCode Feature.
postCreateCommand: mkdir -p "$HOME/.config" "$HOME/.local/share"; if [ ! -e "$HOME/.config/opencode" ]; then ln -s /opencode_config "$HOME/.config/opencode"; fi; if [ ! -e "$HOME/.local/share/opencode" ]; then ln -s /opencode_data "$HOME/.local/share/opencode"; fi
